summary: Fresh independent final canonical audit reread all 225 Chinese units, all 423 temporal or active-hint checks, and all 134 people after the sealed 41-operation date-repair curation. The repaired canonical extraction retains supported chronology and keeps retrospective or posthumous material separate from personal activity. Twenty source-limited records remain explicitly unresolved rather than inventing life chronology; these are preserved research holds, so the chapter cannot yet receive date approval.
